H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H3100: Joel, the name of twelve Israelites

H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)

H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application

H312: properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.

H7910: intoxicated, as astate or a habit
H3213: to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one)
H6071: must or fresh grape-juice (as just trodden out)

H6099: powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H4557: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration

H4973: properly, a biter, i.e. a tooth
H3833: to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;))

H1612: a vine (as twining), especially the grape
H2834: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)

H3001: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
H8492: must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine

H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and

H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)

H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)

H622: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H1524: a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H4053: something thrown off (by the spade), i.e. a clod

H4829: pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H816: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
H4057: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
H3852: {a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon}
H3857: properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze
H650: properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of astream; also a strong thing or a hero
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
